name: tuxedo-site
description: The Tuxedo documentation site, published to GitHub Pages.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/assets && cp src/*.html dist/ && mkdir -p dist/brand && cp ../assets/*.svg dist/brand/ && cp node_modules/preline/dist/preline.js dist/assets/ && tailwindcss -i src/site.css -o dist/assets/site.css --minify
scripts.watch: npm run build && tailwindcss -i src/site.css -o dist/assets/site.css --watch
scripts.serve: npm run build && python3 -m http.server -d dist 8000
